summary: Operations of the user's e-bike battery model (a52.solidcraft, v2) on solidcore: extrude (SmApiCreateLinearSweep), revolve (SmApiCreateRotationalSweep), mirror (SmApiScaleByPt with a -1 scale) and booleans. Dimensions are the model's own: the grommet pocket and bores are Sketch3 (rounded rectangle 43 x 21, corner radius 4, from points p5..p12) and Sketch4 (two circles r 4.2 at x +-11 = grommet_spacing / 2), with the pocket tool (z 3.3 = grommet_panel up to 5, i.e. wall - grommet_panel + 1 = 1.7 long from 1 mm above the wall) and the bore tool (wall + 2 = 6 long); the rail is the rail section reduced to its outline trapezoid (y +-28 at z -0.5, y +-24 at z 12, arcs and cable slots left out) swept from rail_start 44 to rail_end 308, clipped by the rail-ends sketch (trapezoid in XZ through 43..309 / 56..296, z -1.5..12, 108 = depth + 20 deep) and cut by the tunnel sketch (9.6 = band_w + band_fit wide, z 1.5 = tunnel_z to 3.6, clamp_count 4 at clamp_pitch (rail_end - rail_start - 2 * clamp_margin) / 3 from rail_start + clamp_margin 25); the bosses are the ground bosses (four circles r 4 = boss_dia / 2 at x 72.21, 140.31, 185.71, 253.81 and z -4.5, 8 = insert_depth + 1 long) mirrored in XZ; the socket plate is the cell holder plate with its sockets (socket_dia 21.6, socket_depth 3.6, pitch 22.7, plate lip + socket_depth = 5.2 thick); the grommet is the model grommet reduced to a stepped ring (wire_dia 5.5 bore, grommet_flange 13 and grommet_bore 8.4 outside, grommet_panel 3.3 neck). Stand-ins, not in the model: the wall slabs (60 x 40 x wall 4, and 210 x 4 x 30 at y 40..44 for the bosses; the real wall is the rim shell), the plate outline (69.4 x 46.7), the 2 mm flange thickness (gasket_seat) and the 1 mm edge round (bumper_fillet). Every expected volume is a closed form written in its formula. The model's chamfers (rim_chamfer, plate_chamfer, ...) and pipes (the wire harness) have no step; the fillet case stands for them and defers. Both mirror cases defer: SM_API has no mirror (SmBrep::Mirror is SMLib-level, unported), SmEllipse::Transform takes uniform scales only so a (-1, 1, 1) scale cannot move a circular edge, and a uniform -1 scale plus a half turn leaves boolean results with negative volume.

cases.name: grommet_pocket
cases.note: grommet pocket: a rounded-rectangle pocket cut 0.7 deep into the wall (the tool starts 1 mm above it)

volume.formula: 60 * 40 * 4 - (43 * 21 - (4 - pi) * 4^2) * 0.7 (the pocket area is the 43 x 21 rectangle less the four corner squares' (4 - pi) r^2, 0.7 deep: 3.3 to the wall top at 4)

cases.name: grommet_pocket_and_bores
cases.note: grommet pocket then grommet bores: two r 4.2 bores through the wall, crossing the pocket floor

volume.formula: 60 * 40 * 4 - (43 * 21 - (4 - pi) * 4^2) * 0.7 - 2 * pi * 4.2^2 * 3.3 (the bores lie inside the pocket outline, so below its floor at 3.3 they remove 3.3 of wall each)

cases.name: rail_tunnels
cases.note: rail + rail tunnel + tunnel pattern: the rail trapezoid swept along X, four band tunnels cut across it

cases.name: rail_clipped_ends
cases.note: rail ends (intersect): the rail prism cut back by a trapezoid prism whose slanted ends bite into it above z -0.46

volume.formula: int_-0.5^12 w(z) L(z) dz with w(z) = 56 - 0.64 (z + 0.5) and, with s = 13 / 13.5 and z1 = -1.5 + 1 / s, L = 264 for z <= z1 (the rail ends at 44 and 308 bind) and L = 266 - 2 s (z + 1.5) above (the slanted end faces bind); integrand quadratic per piece, evaluated exactly by Simpson

cases.name: rail_clipped_with_tunnels
cases.note: rail joint chain: extrude, intersect, then the four tunnels

volume.formula: the rail_clipped_ends volume less the rail_tunnels cut 4 * 9.6 * 113.5008 = 4358.43072 (the tunnels, x 64.2..73.8 to 278.2..287.8, lie where the clip leaves the full width)

cases.name: boss_pair_mirror_union
cases.note: ground bosses + their mirror: four bosses joined to a wall (one face flush with the wall's), the half mirrored in the XZ plane and joined to its original

volume.formula: 2 * (210 * 4 * 30 + 4 * pi * 4^2 * 4) (each half is the slab plus four bosses, 4 of whose 8 length stand clear of the slab: y 36..40; the mirror image at y -44..-36 shares nothing with it)

cases.name: rail_mirror_stack
cases.note: Mirror1-style reflection of the clipped rail in its top plane z = 12, the two joined face to face along the shared top trapezoid

volume.formula: 2 * the rail_clipped_ends volume 164024.61159763 (the mirror image lies at z 12..24.5 and shares only the top face)

cases.name: grommet_revolve_full
cases.note: grommet: a stepped ring revolved a full turn about the Y axis

volume.formula: pi * ((6.5^2 - 2.75^2) * 2 + (4.2^2 - 2.75^2) * 3.3) (Pappus: the flange ring 2 thick and the neck ring 3.3 long)

cases.name: grommet_revolve_270
cases.note: grommet with angle 270 instead of 360: the capped partial sweep

cases.name: socket_pattern
cases.note: cell holder plate + sockets: a 3 x 2 grid of cylindrical sockets 3.6 deep on the 22.7 pitch

volume.formula: 69.4 * 46.7 * 5.2 - 6 * pi * 10.8^2 * 3.6 (the sockets, 21.6 across on a 22.7 pitch, leave 1.1 between them)

cases.name: plate_edge_fillet
cases.note: the model's fillets (bumper_fillet 1 mm and the like) on a wall slab edge; no Rust SmApiFilletEdges yet, so this defers

volume.formula: 60 * 40 * 4 - (1 - pi / 4) * 1^2 * 60 (a quarter-round of radius 1 along the 60 long edge)
